Your five closest friends may shape more than you think.

Kevin Trudeau quotes Aristotle Onassis, who said the most important thing you can do for success is to associate with people who earn more than you do.

Kevin's point is to surround yourself with positive, motivated, inspired people, ideally a level above you, because all boats go up on a rising tide.

Who are you becoming through the company you keep?
